tasks.short: Write up the yearly pay research for managers and the works council.

today.trigger: Once a year, when the pay file is frozen, or when a CAO change means Noordhaven has to explain grades, allowances or gaps again.
steps: Collect the year's market notes, the CAO texts, and the pay figures from the Power BI report on the nightly AFAS extract.
Decide which findings go in the manager manual, which go in the works-council note, and which a shift lead can be told.
Write the manual in Word, a short PowerPoint for the HR Director, and place the accepted file on SharePoint.
Recheck every band, allowance and headcount against AFAS and the CAO article.
Send the works-council version through Outlook and collect the comments.
drudgery: Retyping the same numbers into Word, PowerPoint and the SharePoint page.
Fixing layout, version names and broken cross-references.
Re-checking every figure after wording comments that did not change the numbers.
today.time_sinks: Of the roughly sixteen hours, most goes into rewriting one set of findings into three formats and rechecking figures by hand. Deciding what may be said takes a few hours.

lenses.faster: The rewrite of the same findings into Word, PowerPoint and a SharePoint page disappears, because the draft is built from the notes and named source cells. Deciding what Noordhaven will stand behind, and checking every band, allowance and CAO citation, stays and takes about seven hours.
lenses.autonomous: It starts when the yearly pay extract is frozen in Power BI, or when a CAO text changes the explanation. The three drafts are produced from that extract and the specialist's notes, and nothing is published until the specialist signs and the HR Director has seen the works-council version.
lenses.ambitious: A two-page Dutch briefing for night-shift team leads and flex coordinators at Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo, covering the scale and allowances for their crews. Demand would grow if a checked draft were cheap, because each CAO round and each new team lead raises the same questions, and the pay-transparency bill gives employees a two-month answer time once it applies.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss copying figures between Excel, Word and PowerPoint, or repairing layout on SharePoint. The work worth keeping is judging which finding is strong enough to show, and answering the warehouse questions the yearly pack skips.
lenses.options: A works-council version that splits the gap by site, and one that splits it by job family, lead the council to different follow-up questions. A team-lead page that prints the band as a range, and one that prints the step rules, change whether the lead treats pay as negotiable.
lenses.altitude: This yearly job shrinks from about two days to a half-day review, and the rest of the week stays on grades, gaps and manager questions. The specialist gains the say on which findings are fit to publish and which stay in the working file, so the expertise sits in the public wording of pay and in the evidence under each figure.
reach: The HR Business Partner's briefing of the three sites when an allowance or grade changes. The specialist would need to learn each site's shift pattern and how agency workers are paid there.
The People Analytics analyst's short written readout of the yearly pay dashboard. The specialist would need to learn the Power BI measures and which AFAS fields feed a gap figure.

tasks.human_edge: The specialist knows which wording the works council has already accepted, which allowance the warehouse CAO actually pays, and when a smooth paragraph would invent a driver grade the sector parties have not settled. They also see when a chart would identify a small team at one site or a thin job family, and that call has to be made before anything is published.
tasks.pattern_why: The notes, CAO text and market commentary are messy, and the outputs are three known documents whose figures can be checked against a source cell. The steps are the same each year, so one draft pass inside a fixed workflow is enough, with the specialist signing the result.

in_practice.trigger: The yearly AFAS pay extract is marked frozen in Power BI, or a new CAO text changes grades or allowances Noordhaven has to explain.
steps: The specialist marks the frozen extract, the CAO articles and the notes that may be quoted, and marks anything that stays in the working file.
One model pass drafts the manager manual, the works-council note and the shift-lead one-pager in Dutch, with each figure tied to a source cell or article.
The specialist corrects any line that overstates a band, mixes the transport CAO with the warehouse CAO, or could identify a small group.
The HR Director reads the works-council version before it is sent.
The signed texts replace the previous versions on SharePoint, with the extract date on the cover.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist signs every document before it is published. The HR Director signs the version that goes to the works council, and any line that states a band outside what the CAO already settles.
data_needed: AFAS job scheme, scale, allowance and FTE by site, split by the transport CAO and the warehouse CAO.
The CAO articles in force and the status of the sector regrade.
Market notes the specialist has already accepted, with the date and the source.
Agency headcount and pay figures the three agencies allow Noordhaven to reuse.
Who may open each document on SharePoint.
in_practice.logs_to: The signed pack on the HR SharePoint, with the AFAS extract date on the cover and a short list of lines the specialist changed before signing, kept with the pay policy so a later question can be traced to the same figures.

evidence.claim: A pay or grading system needs works council consent, except where a collective agreement already settles it or for a mandatory industry pension fund, so the text that explains grades is a formal document.

Randstad's reading of the Dutch pay-transparency bill: pay requests are answered within two months, agency workers count and agencies supply their pay data, and an unexplained gap of 5% or more that lasts six months triggers a joint evaluation with the works council. Debate was expected in December 2026 and January 2027, with the start set by royal decree, and the first report covers 2027 pay and is due by 7 June 2028.
AFAS Profit 8 stores job schemes and categories as fields in preparation for pay transparency, so the numbers in a manual can be taken from the HR record.
The parties to CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer are regrading the sector's jobs and had not published an outcome, so a manual that freezes driver grades can go stale.
Published practice warns against a fresh job evaluation just because AI has changed how a role is described, where the core accountabilities have not materially changed.
A grade printed in a manual that does not match the payroll record becomes an unexplained pay difference, and a pay decision must not be taken by a model alone.

risks: A fluent sentence states an allowance or a step the CAO does not pay, and a team lead treats the SharePoint page as a promise.
Driver grades and warehouse grades are written as one scale, or the page freezes driver grades while the sector parties are still regrading them.
A gap chart with a small group at Venlo or in a thin job family can be read back to a person, and the SharePoint audience is wider than HR.
Rate data from the three staffing agencies may sit outside what those contracts allow Noordhaven to reuse in an internal manual.

If the draft proposes the grade rather than the wording, the pay decision must stay with the specialist. From 2 December 2027 a tool that recommends grades or pay can be high-risk, and then needs oversight, logs and prior notice to the works council.
research_questions: In the last manual cycle, how many of the sixteen hours were formatting and rewriting, and how many were deciding what Noordhaven could stand behind? If judgment is already most of the time, the saving is small.
Which figures the manual cites are in the nightly AFAS extract today, and which live only in the specialist's Excel? A draft cannot be checked if the source cell does not exist.
Will the works council discuss a model draft that the specialist signs, or will they only discuss text the specialist wrote themselves?

Do night-shift team leads and flex coordinators already have a usable Dutch explanation, and which pay-transparency duties are actually in force by royal decree before Noordhaven writes the first report on 2027 pay?

role.altitude: The specialist moves from grading one job and answering one allowance at a time to holding the job architecture and the sourced evidence behind every pay difference Noordhaven has to explain, across both CAOs and the agency workers.
reach: The HR Business Partner's explanation to the three sites when a scale or allowance changes, after learning each site's shifts and agency arrangements.
The People Analytics analyst's written commentary on the yearly pay and gap view in Power BI, after learning the measures behind it.
The Controller's first sketch of what a CAO wage rise costs in headcount and scale, with Finance still owning the forecast and the ledger.
The Payroll Specialist's check that a new allowance matches the CAO before it is loaded in AFAS, after learning the wage-component setup.
role.ceiling_note: This publication task is about sixteen hours a year, so tooling on it does not change the loaded cost of the 1 FTE. The ceiling is one specialist, the two CAO texts, works-council consent, and merit and complaint work that stays with the person. The transparency report on 2027 pay, due by 7 June 2028, and the transport pension scheme change expected on 1 January 2027 if drivers are in Pensioenfonds Vervoer, are peaks this seat can absorb only by dropping ad-hoc manager advice.
skills_to_grow: Job evaluation on skills, responsibilities, effort and working conditions, and the line between a grade the CAO settles and one the works council must consent to.
Pay-gap arithmetic from the AFAS extract, including agency workers, and what Noordhaven can defend as an explained difference.
Plain Dutch for a works-council paper and for a warehouse team lead, with each figure tied to a source.
Enough of the applicable pension scheme to say what changes in 2027, after confirming which fund covers drivers and which covers warehouse staff.
role.ambitious_version: The specialist keeps a living pay library: every grade, allowance and explained gap has a source, a Dutch text a site lead can use, and a works-council version inside the consent already given. Employee and council questions are answered from that library inside the bill's two-month window once the rules apply, including agency workers. Offer acceptance and 90-day retention move because a new hire has seen the band and the reason before the first payslip, and the week is spent on architecture, disputed gaps and the cases the CAO does not settle.
